tools.name: get_privacy_grade
tools.description: Get the automated privacy grade (A+ to F) and per-dimension scan results for a SaaS tool. Use the slug from the directory (e.g. "notion", "google-analytics", "slack").

tools.name: get_compliance_info
tools.description: Get self-reported compliance certifications (SOC 2, HIPAA BAA, PCI DSS), DPA link, and trust center URL for a SaaS tool.

tools.name: lookup_tool
tools.description: Search the ComplianceCheckup directory of 900+ SaaS tools by name. Returns matching tools with their slugs so you can use get_privacy_grade or get_compliance_info.

params.name: name
params.description: Tool name to search for, e.g. "HubSpot", "Google Analytics", "Salesforce"

tools.name: list_tools
tools.description: List tools in the ComplianceCheckup directory, optionally filtered by category.

params.name: category
params.description: Filter by category, e.g. "CRM", "Analytics", "AI / ML", "Project Management"

tools.name: get_checklist
tools.description: Get the full compliance checklist for a regulation with all items, source citations from official regulatory text, and detailed explanations. Available: gdpr, hipaa, pcidss, soc2, ccpa, ada (WCAG accessibility).

params.name: category
params.description: Optional: filter to a specific category within the checklist
